answer_1.quote: Dialogue summarization generates concise summaries of dialogues... We explore Semi-Supervised Dialogue Summarization (SSDS), aiming to enhance dialogue summarization by a small labeled dataset alongside a large collection of unlabeled dialogues.

answer_2.quote: Metrics for SSDS are BERTScore, ROUGE-1, -2, and -L... We report the mean of metric performance between 0-50% and between 0-90%.

answer_4.quote: We had 5 participants for the human evaluation test. We presented each person with the same 100 testing samples... each person was asked the question "Among the four generated dialogue summaries, which is the best when compared to the original dialogues and ground truth dialogue summaries?"
answer_4.guideline: Select the best generated summary compared to the original dialogue and ground‑truth summary.
